_about: Hand-written questions. `gold` lists transcript timestamps that contain the answer; a retrieved chunk counts as relevant if it includes any of them. `kind` is `lexical` when the question shares distinctive words with the answer and `paraphrase` when it does not. `gold: []` marks a question the transcript cannot answer.
